title: Knowledge Editing with Dynamic Knowledge Graphs for Multi-Hop Question Answering
authors: Yifan Lu; Yigeng Zhou; Jing Li; Yequan Wang; Xuebo Liu; Daojing He; Fangming Liu; Min Zhang
why_relevant: Addresses knowledge conflicts arising from secondary edits in knowledge editing for multi-hop QA via dynamic KG-augmented retrieval, tangentially related to retrieved-vs-retrieved conflict.
